facts.material: electronic components (DSP chipset) in metal housing
facts.function: receives and processes audio signals: D/A conversion, crossover frequency division, equalization, level adjustment; no amplification
facts.form: complete standalone processor with RCA/XLR/S/PDIF I/O and wireless connectivity

gri_path: GRI 1: not an amplifier (8518.40) or loudspeaker (8518.21/.22) since it performs no amplification and emits no sound

GRI 1: not a part of loudspeakers under Section XVI note 2 because it is a separate apparatus with an individual function; heading 8543 covers electrical apparatus having individual functions not elsewhere specified
GRI 6: 8543.70 other machines and apparatus; 8543.70.98 other (not a DSP apparatus for mixing of sound on a network); 8543.70.98.60 other (not an amplifier or effects pedal)

rejected_alternatives.reason: device does not amplify audio signals
not a part of a loudspeaker; it is a standalone signal processor with its own function (Section XVI note 2(a) sends goods of a specific heading to that heading)
that line covers networked DSP apparatus for the mixing of sound; this device divides frequencies/equalizes rather than mixes multiple sources (arguable)

missing_facts: Does the device mix multiple audio input sources and connect to a network (would support 8543.70.91.00)?
classification.rationale: The DSP receives audio signals and performs D/A conversion, crossover, equalization and level control but performs no amplification, so it is not an audio-frequency amplifier of 8518.40. It is an electrical apparatus with an individual function not specified elsewhere in chapter 85, falling in 8543.70. CBP classified a similar digital-to-analog audio control unit without amplification in 8543 (J80321, in force). The residual line 8543.70.98.60 applies unless the device is a networked sound-mixing DSP.
